text:
maya: Heads up — staging perf CI blew up after today's merge (PR #4512). p99 generator latency x3 on several models. Rolling rollout paused. Anyone already looking?
runtime-ci-bot: [PERF ALERT] staging: generator p99 2200ms -> 6800ms. Report: https://ci.redwood/reports/3123
josh: Running a quick profile on a repro trace. Early suspicion: kernel_selector keeps choosing small-kernel for longer sequences because tokenizer now emits extra zero-width tokens (U+200C) — logical length increased but kernel path wrong.
rachel: KV cache miss spike at the same time. Prefetcher warmup looks starved for longer prefixes; alignment shifted after tokenization change.
josh: Bisecting the last 6 merges now. Repro command:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"<long prompt>"}' https://staging.redwood/api/generate --resolve 'staging.redwood:127.0.0.1' --profile-kernel > /tmp/profile.json
```
deploy-bot: Rollout paused: canary 2/5 halted due to latency alarm :rotating_light:
ankit: Quick check: kernel_selector logic currently chooses `fast_matmul` for seq<=128 else `large_matmul`. If tokenizer normalization causes some sequences to round up to 129, we flip execution path and large kernel warmup + mem heuristics kick in.
josh: Bisect point found: commit 7a9c8f2 changed tokenizer.normalize to collapse ZWJ sequences -> introduced trailing ZWJ tokens for some languages. Reverting that change locally brings p99 back to baseline.
rachel: Profiling snippet (excerpt from /tmp/profile.json):
```
KernelLauncher::select_kernel: before: small=78%, large=22%
after: small=12%, large=88%
KV cache hit-rate drop: ~30%
```
dylan: If kernel selection flips to large kernel, batch scheduler creates longer micro-batches due to memory heuristics -> p99 climbs. Suggest temporary revert + add guard in kernel_selector to compute tokenized_seq_len from pre-normalized tokens.
maya: Agree. Action items: josh to open revert PR for tokenizer normalize change; ankit to add selector guard; rachel to run a perf smoke on staging after revert. @josh can you own the revert?
josh: :thumbsup: I'll open revert PR and attach perf run. Repro report: https://ci.redwood/reports/3123. ETA ~30m.
runtime-ci-bot: Perf CI queued for branch `josh/revert-tokenize-7a9c8f2`. Expect results ~12m.
rachel: If revert helps, we schedule a small canary (10% traffic) and monitor KV eviction + p99. Also add a CI test to catch tokenizer->kernel compatibility regressions.
maya: Thanks all. Keep short updates here. Marking incident as rollout-blocker.
